_meta.source: Cboe delayed quotes (cdn.cboe.com); prices are bid/ask midpoints
_meta.universe: Top 300 of the Vance value ranking

filters.liquidity: Open interest 500+ and bid/ask spread at most 10% of the midpoint

_meta.vol_rank_note: Volatility rank: true IV Rank once a stock has about a year of saved implied volatility; until then, where today's 30-day implied volatility sits within the range of the stock's own 30-day realized volatility over the past year (0 = bottom of that range, 100 = top).
_meta.pmcc_rule: Sound when the gap between the two strikes is larger than the net cost; otherwise being assigned on the short call locks in a loss.
_meta.disclaimer: Educational research only, not investment advice. Options can lose 100% of what is paid for them, and quotes are delayed.
